messages:
Michael H.: FYI hit a weird case in the exports where the same policy-change shows up twice for the same user within 1s. Not sure if it's a producer bug or our dedupe on the export side. Anyone seen this pattern?
Priya S.: Seen it once. Usually from parallel rollouts where webhook and console both emit events. We tried adding a producer id but not sure it's in the NDJSON schema for exports.
Jun L.: Can you paste the raw lines? If it's two different event ids we should probably surface merge-hints in the UI instead of silently dropping one.
Michael H.: paste: ```{\n  "event_id":"evt_01F...A","actor":"u_123","change":"route:update","meta":{"source":"console","policy_id":"p_77"}\n}\n{\n  "event_id":"evt_01F...B","actor":"u_123","change":"route:update","meta":{"source":"webhook","policy_id":"p_77"}\n}```
Kelly B.: From UX perspective we can't just merge. Users need to know both sources emitted something. Suggest: show a compact cluster in the timeline with a badge: "2 events, likely duplicate" and allow expand to see both. Also provide an api field in the export to indicate clustering-hint.
Priya S.: Clustering-hint sounds OK. Backend could emit a "cluster_key" computed as sha(actor+policy_id+change+minute-window). That way downstream exporters can group. But we must be careful with privacy: hashing must be salted per-tenant.
Maria P.: +1 on salt per-tenant. Also we need to document PII implications — actor hashes still count as pseudonymous data in some regions. If someone requests a full export for legal reasons we must be able to map back. How would mapping work if salted?
Sam R.: For legal exports we can include mapping tables in a privileged bundle (not in the default NDJSON). Those bundles should be gated by role and audit-logged.
Jun L.: Implementation note: cluster_key would be optional string in top-level event. Example: ``"cluster_key":"sha1:abcd..."``. Exports consumer can choose to apply server-side dedupe or surface clusters.
Priya S.: Also quota implication: clustering on the console view vs raw export changes unit counts. If we cluster in the console we might hide bursty producers, but exports consumers (SIEM) expect raw fidelity. Need a policy: console clusters by default, raw exports always include raw_event.* lines and optional cluster_key.
Kelly B.: UX flow: timeline shows clustered row, with disclosure to "show raw events". For exports UI (download modal) default to raw for compliance customers, and an option "include cluster hints only" for noise-reduction.
Michael H.: One more: signing/presigned links. If we bundle mapping tables for legal needs we must ensure presigned expiry and S3 encryption, and audit-bot logs the download. audit-bot: granted? :eyes:
audit-bot: Action recorded: export_request by Michael H. (env:prod, method:console-download, id:exp_202603).
Sam R.: Ops checklist: ensure export generation respects retention redaction flags (pii_redaction_mode), and mapping tables are stored to KMS-encrypted S3 with separate ACL.
Maria P.: We should add a field in export manifest: ``pii_mapping_included": "yes|no", "mapping_location": "s3://..." so downstream legal teams can find it.
Jun L.: Agree. I'll add cluster_key, manifest fields, and a flag export_mode: raw|clustered in the API. Patch coming to route-audit-proto v2.
Priya S.: Heads up: consumers (splunk/syslog) will need schema bump notice. We should version the NDJSON: header line: `#schema:route-audit.v2` so parsers can detect new optional fields.
Kelly B.: I'll wire the console copy to check the header and show a compatibility warning if the tenant uses older SIEM connectors.
Michael H.: Nice. Timeline: Priya/Ju n work on proto by EOD Fri, Jun add cluster_key, Sam handle S3 & KMS, Kelly update modal, Maria write privacy note. Can we get a quick review once the PR is in?
Priya S.: Yep — will tag @Jun and @Sam.
Jun L.: PR link will be posted in this thread.
Kelly B.: UX mocks will go into Figma under "audit/cluster-ux".
Michael H.: Thanks all. If anyone runs into edge cases (e.g., concurrent edits from 3 producers) add notes to the PR.
Priya S.: Followup: thinking about dedupe window — 30s seems reasonable, but we should run a small job to sample patterns before locking it in.
Sam R.: I'll schedule a one-off mapreduce to compute typical inter-event deltas by policy and actor.
Michael H.: Perfect. Done for now. :thumbsup:
